misc-permutations.note: Type 1 LOOPs page. Recipe: constraintPreset smooth + motionTypeFilter no-dash + mustNotContainLetters [Type 2 set, alpha, beta, gamma] forces pure Type 1 words. Steps captured verbatim from MCP generate_sequence (beat keys mapped to step). Phase 0 findings recorded in the rollout spec: mustContainLetters is a post-hoc filter in loop mode (fails instead of steering); startPosition may be overridden by loop closure; server still runs pre-fix engine so closure retries may be needed.
curationFlags: IIII appears in BOTH the mirrored and rotated-swapped slots (different instances). Pedagogically neat (same word, two closures) but may read samey on one page; likely cut one.
EKEJ appears in BOTH the rotated-swapped and mirrored-swapped slots (different instances). Same consideration.
FLFLFLFL (rotated-swapped) and LFLFLFLF (mirrored-swapped) are the same letter family reversed. Same consideration.

type2-loops.note: Type 2 LOOPs page: rotated loops that travel between alpha/beta and gamma via Type 2 connector letters. Recipe: loopType rotated + smooth + no-dash + startPosition in the slot's family; travel through gamma verified per candidate (no direct constraint exists). Slots keyed by the start family of the page's three print examples (BΣTX alpha, EΔUZ beta, OYHΘ gamma).
curationFlags: OYΘT (gamma slot) is one letter away from the page's own default OYHΘ. Either a feature (minimal variation) or too close; Austen's call.
Three candidates are ALL-Type-2 words (ΩXΔZ beta slot, ZΩXΔ and WΔZΘ gamma slot). Strong teaching value but three of them may be repetitive across one page.
Page's shared trio prose stays as flow prose; per-slot entry-0 prose must be drafted at migration (none exists today).

gamma-loops.note: Gamma LOOPs page: rotated loops that never leave gamma. Recipe: loopType rotated + smooth + no-dash + gamma start + mustNotContainLetters [Type 2 set, alpha, beta, gamma] (with no connectors available, the word cannot leave gamma; verified per candidate anyway). POOL SIZE 7, NOT 12: the level-1 smooth gamma word space is small and draws started repeating (UUUU, OROO, MPMN all came back twice); quality over padding. Candidates split across slots by letter family to match each slot's default.
curationFlags: Slot pools are 2-3 deep here instead of 4 (small word space; see note).

Single-letter words (VVVV, UUUU, SSST near-single) overlap in spirit with the lt1-gamma-words page's pinned MPMP/SSSS gallery; the LOOP framing is different but Austen may want more mixed words instead.

Page's shared trio prose stays as flow prose; per-slot entry-0 prose must be drafted at migration (none exists today). The hardcoded shared start box in gamma-loops.content.ts (Γ, blue S / red E) applies to the AUTHORED strips only; pooled entries carry their own start boxes.
